rationale: Rahul and Venkat Ram both work in computer vision and robotics—Rahul is deploying robotic systems for agricultural field labor at AgRobotics, while Venkat Ram specializes in robotics manipulation and computer vision as an ML engineer at Syndio. Venkat's expertise in Python, C++, and machine learning could directly complement Rahul's engineering work on autonomous agricultural robots, making them natural collaborators on technical implementation challenges.
intro_message: Rahul, meet Venkat Ram — he's an ML engineer focused on robotics and computer vision, and could be a great technical sounding board for the robotic systems you're building at AgRobotics.
